messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired: PD-12234 — POP connectivity degradation reported in pop-mia1. Severity: P1. Affected service: CDN edge routing.

maya (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing >10% packet loss to pop-mia1 from our health checks. Graph: https://grafana/.../pop-mia1/packetloss

raj (sre): Confirming from infra: healthcheck probes show spikes at 04:13 UTC, 04:16 UTC. Route flaps in BGP history from transit provider. Starting basic scope:
- which customers routed to mia1?
- any recent deploys to edge control plane?

tom (network-eng): Provider (CarrierA) reported partial NP outage in MIA region. BGP withdraws observed. I'm pulling BGP dumps now. Running:

```
bgp-monitor dump --peer carrierA --prefix 198.51.100.0/24
```

sarah (prod-ops): Quick mitigation: can we shift traffic to pop-fll1 (same metro) and pop-atl1? Need to update traffic steering policy in control plane.

maya (oncall): On it. Initiating manual steer: `redwood route set --from pop-mia1 --to pop-fll1 --policy immediate --max-shift 60%`

leo (cs): Heads up — 2 enterprise customers on dedicated routes reported 502 errors. Raising with their CSMs now. ETA for customer messages?

maya (oncall): Sending short status update to affected customers now. Minimal details: "Experiencing degraded connectivity in Miami POP; traffic being rerouted. Engineering investigating."

pagerduty: User ack: maya acknowledged incident PD-12234 at 2025-03-15T04:14:30Z

raj (sre): After steering, packet loss on end-to-end tests to pop-mia1 dropped from 15%->3%, but latency increased for some prefixes. Monitoring for anomalous cache misses.

tom (network-eng): BGP dumps show a path prepending loop from transit provider toward our AS that correlates with the time of spike. I filed a ticket with carrierA. Meanwhile I pushed an emergency ACL on our edge routers to drop malformed announcements and prevented further re-advertise.

maya (oncall): Can we enable fallback model for hostnames served from mia1 so devs get deterministic failover instead of 502s? `console -> routing -> failover: enabled` — turning on now.

sarah (prod-ops): Rolling the failover flag. Logging customers that hit fallback so PMs can follow up.

leo (cs): Noting: two customers on dedicated capacity saw failed requests but had auto-retry and recovered after 30s. One high-throughput streaming customer degraded for ~12 minutes before successful reroute.

raj (sre): For postmortem: collect BGP dumps, router logs (edge), healthcheck history, routing policy changes, and customer error rates from telemetry. Possible RCA: transit provider BGP instability + our insufficiently conservative fallback thresholds.

tom (network-eng): CarrierA confirms partial routing issue — they will propagate full fix in 12-18 minutes. Proposed permanent mitigations: extra peering with backup provider, BGP route dampening tune, and automation to shift traffic earlier.

maya (oncall): Next steps for handoff to night oncall @ben: I'll summarize actions in #oncall-handoff and tag you. Current status: traffic shifted to FLL/ATL, carrier issue being fixed, customer impact limited but non-zero. No data loss. Mitigation in place.

maya (oncall): /me adds followup items:
- owner: tom for carrier coordination + peering plan
- owner: raj for telemetry/alert tuning
- owner: sarah for incident communication and CS followups
- owner: maya for initial postmortem draft

pagerduty: Incident PD-12234 status changed to "watching" by maya at 2025-03-15T04:28:10Z

leo (cs): Thanks all. I've sent proactive messages to affected CSMs with timeline and next steps.

ben (oncall): picking up handoff. I'll keep watch for flapping and confirm when carrier says fully reverted. If things look stable in 30m I'll close the incident.

maya (oncall): handoff notes sent to #oncall-handoff. Log pointers:
- Grafana board: https://grafana/.../pop-mia1
- BGP dumps: s3://redwood-ops/bgp/2155008888
- Router config delta: https://git.redwood/edge-config/commits/2155

ben (oncall): got it. Adding to my watchlist. If any retries remain >5% for >15m I'll escalate to netlead.

incident-bot: Incident PD-12234 auto-closed: No new alerts for 30m after 2025-03-15T05:00:00Z — will file for postmortem drafting window.

maya (oncall): Opening postmortem doc and assigning to tom/raj. I'll attach timeline and mitigation steps. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
